title: manihot dulcis var. multifida
intro: Manihot dulcis var. multifida, commonly known as Poi Mulch or Hawaiian Poi Plant, is a variety of the Manihot dulcis plant, a species of the Euphorbiaceae family. It is a tropical plant native to Hawaii and is also known as the 'Multi-leafed Manioc' or 'Poi Plant'. The health benefits of Manihot dulcis var. multifida include its ability to regulate blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and provide antioxidant properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, and its therapeutic actions include anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
